info.title: Wellfed server
info.description: The owner's server: mirrors each feeder's history and serves it to the web UI and the app. Unstable until the first release.

get.summary:
The journal, oldest first: the caller's own writes, or everyone's for
an owner. `state=unknown` lists the writes whose outcome is uncertain.

parameters.name: feeder
parameters.description: One feeder's writes only.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Writes in this state only: `unknown` is the uncertain list.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The previous page's `next`, as it came.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many (1-1000, default 100).

400.description: invalid: a bad limit or cursor

get.summary:
One write, by the `Idempotency-Key` it was sent under. Another user's
is not found, unless the caller is an owner.
The adopted feeders, with the server's connection to each.

post.summary: Adopt a feeder by redeeming an invite its owner made for the server.

400.description: invalid: not an invite, or no address

get.summary:
One feeder and its status: live when it is online, otherwise the last
copy, marked.

delete.summary:
Remove the feeder from the server: revoke the server's key on it,
stop mirroring it and archive it, whether or not the revoke landed,
which the answer says. Its history, samples and journal stay readable;
adopting it again brings it back with them.

get.summary:
The feeder's clients, read from it, each with whose it is to the
server: its own key, a phone it invited, one an owner kept, or unowned.

delete.summary:
Revoke one of the feeder's clients. A phone's key is forgotten with it.
The feeder lets only an owner's key revoke: a server adopted with the
`server` role is refused `forbidden`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID; a retry with the same key is answered once

400.description: invalid: the server's own key (remove the feeder instead)

409.description: feeder_archived, or feeder_refused (not_found: no such client)

504.description: outcome_unknown: retry with the same key

post.summary:
Keep a client the server did not invite, so it is no longer listed as
unowned. Nothing is sent to the feeder.

get.summary: The feeder's history as the server holds it, oldest first.

parameters.name: epoch
parameters.description: The history to read; the feeder's current one when absent.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Events after this sequence number; from the oldest when absent.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many (1-500, default 100).

post.summary:
Feed now. Answered once the feeder has reserved the feed: the journal
entry, with the feeder's number for it in `feed`. Its result arrives on
the stream and at `GET /commands/{key}`; a retry under the same key
returns the entry as it stands and never feeds again.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID; a retry with the same key is answered once

400.description: invalid: a malformed body, or a missing or malformed Idempotency-Key

409.description: feeder_refused: nothing ran; final for this key, so a new feed needs a new key

422.description: key_reused: the key names another request; nothing was sent

504.description: outcome_unknown: never sent again; its result is read at GET /commands/{key}

post.summary:
Stop the feed with this number if it still runs. Its result is still
its `Fed` event, `cancelled`, with the portions it gave. A retry of a
cancel whose outcome was unknown may be refused `not_found`: the feed
has ended, perhaps by the first attempt, and its `Fed` event says how.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID; a retry with the same key is answered once

400.description: invalid: a malformed Idempotency-Key

409.description: feeder_refused: not_found once the feed has ended

504.description: outcome_unknown: retry with the same key

get.summary: The food the feeder serves now, and its newest refill.

put.summary:
Serve another food from now on; past feeds keep the food they served.
Choosing the food the feeder already serves keeps its period.

404.description: not_found: the feeder or the food

get.summary:
The foods the feeder has served, oldest first, each with when it
started and ended.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The previous page's `next`, as it came.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many (1-1000, default 100).

400.description: invalid: a bad `after` or `limit`

post.summary:
An invite for the caller's own phone, which joins the feeder with the
key it names, on the LAN, with its account's role. Only a phone's
token gets one, for an owner or a member with no expiry on the account
or the token. One key per token: the token's other key on the feeder
is revoked. The invite holds a secret, is shown once and is never
resent: a caller that lost it asks again.

409.description: client_key_taken, feeder_archived, or feeder_refused (forbidden: the server's key is not an owner's)

504.description: outcome_unknown: ask for a new invite

post.summary: Lock or unlock the feeder's panel.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID; a retry with the same key is answered once

400.description: invalid: a malformed body or Idempotency-Key

409.description: feeder_refused: final for this key; a later attempt needs a new key

504.description: outcome_unknown: retry with the same key

post.summary:
Play a tune now; refused `muted` while the sound setting is off. The
firmware steps its speaker only in setup mode for now, so it refuses
`unavailable` in the loop.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID; a retry with the same key is answered once

504.description: outcome_unknown: retry with the same key

post.summary:
Restart the feeder; refused `busy` while a feed is queued or runs. One
whose outcome is unknown is never resent: the boot count says whether
it ran.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID; a retry with the same key is answered once

get.summary: The feeder's refills, in the order they were recorded.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The previous page's `next`, as it came.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many (1-1000, default 100).

400.description: invalid: a bad `after` or `limit`

post.summary:
Record a refill made now: a weighed amount, or a full bag of the
feeder's current food.

400.description: invalid: an amount out of range

409.description: no_current_food: a full bag on a feeder with no food set

delete.summary: Remove a refill recorded by mistake.

get.summary:
The feeder's settings, read from it. The `ETag` is the generation a
change sends back in `If-Match`.

patch.summary: Change settings, if they are still at the generation in `If-Match`.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The generation the change is based on

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID; a retry with the same key is answered once

400.description: invalid: a malformed body, If-Match or Idempotency-Key

409.description: feeder_refused: final for this key; a later attempt needs a new key

504.description: outcome_unknown: retry with the same key

put.summary:
Store Wi-Fi credentials for the feeder's next join, or clear them, if
its Wi-Fi store is still at the generation in `If-Match` (the status's
`wifi_generation`). The passphrase is never stored or echoed.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The generation the change is based on

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID; a retry with the same key is answered once

400.description: invalid: an SSID or passphrase out of range

409.description: feeder_archived, or feeder_refused (stale: read the status again; forbidden: the server's key is not an owner's)

504.description: outcome_unknown: retry with the same key

get.summary: Every food, by brand and name.

post.summary: Add a food. A cup is 110 g unless `grams_per_cup` says otherwise.

400.description: invalid: a brand, name or amount out of range

delete.summary: Delete a food that no feeder has served and no refill names.

409.description: food_in_use: a feeder's history or a refill names it

patch.summary:
Change a food. Feeders' histories keep naming it, so the change applies
to past feeds too: a new recipe is a new food.

400.description: invalid: a brand, name or amount out of range

get.summary: The household, as every user's pages show it.

patch.summary:
Change the household. A new zone goes to every feeder as its POSIX rule:
the online ones now, the others when they reconnect.

400.description: invalid: a name, or an unknown zone

422.description: zone_unsupported: no POSIX rule describes the zone

get.summary: Every pet, by name, each with the feeders that serve it.

post.summary: Add a pet. It starts with no feeders and an empty weight log.

400.description: invalid: a name, or a daily target out of range

delete.summary: Delete a pet, with its weight log and its feeders' links.

patch.summary: Change a pet; `null` clears its birth date or daily target.

400.description: invalid: a name, or a daily target out of range

put.summary:
Let a feeder serve the pet. A feeder that already does is left as it
is.

404.description: not_found: the pet or the feeder

delete.summary: Stop a feeder serving the pet.

404.description: not_found: the pet, or the feeder does not serve it

get.summary: The pet's weight log, oldest reading first.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The previous page's `next`, as it came.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many (1-1000, default 100).

400.description: invalid: a bad `after` or `limit`

post.summary: Log a weight, taken now unless `at` says when.

400.description: invalid: a weight out of range

delete.summary: Remove an entry from the pet's weight log.

get.summary:
The phone keys the server invited: everyone's for an owner, one's own
for anyone else. A key being revoked shows why and what its last
attempt came to, so a feeder that still holds it is reported.
The verified releases the server holds, newest version first.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The `next` of the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many (1-1000, default 100).

400.description: invalid: a bad `after` or `limit`

post.summary:
Upload a release file (a signed manifest, then the image it names),
for an offline home or a self-built image. It is verified as a fetched
one is, against the project's keys and the owner's.

Check the project's GitHub releases now, keeping each new one that
verifies. The server also checks daily while fetching is on.

get.summary: The logged-in user.

post.summary: Log in. The session lasts 30 days from its last use.

patch.summary:
Change one's own password, given the current one. Every other session
of the account ends; this one stays, and so do the account's tokens.
Only from a login, never a token.

400.description: invalid: a password under 10 characters

get.summary:
Whether a fresh server is waiting for its first owner, and the host's
zone, which the setup page offers as the household's.

post.summary:
Create the first owner and the household in its zone, and log the owner
in. Closed once any account exists.

201.description: Created; the session cookie is set

400.description: invalid: a name, a password under 10 characters, or an unknown zone

422.description: zone_unsupported: no POSIX rule describes the zone

get.summary:
Readiness: whether the database answers, each feeder's link and the
background jobs' last runs. A failing database is reported in the body,
not as an error.

Live updates for every feeder: events, gaps, connection changes, the
sample metrics asked for, and changes to the caller's journal entries
(everyone's for an owner), a feed's result among them.

parameters.name: samples
parameters.description:
The sample metrics to include, comma-separated (`power,rssi`); none
when absent.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Resume after this event

get.summary:
The caller's own tokens, or everyone's for an owner, oldest first. A
token's secret is never listed.

post.summary:
Make a token for the logged-in user's device. The answer holds its
secret, the only time the server shows it; the token lasts until
revoked, or until its expiry if it has one.

400.description: invalid: a name, or an expiry already past

403.description: session_required: a token cannot make another

delete.summary:
Revoke a token: the caller's own, or anyone's for an owner. Another
user's is not found.

get.summary: Every account, by name.

post.summary:
Add an account, with a temporary password the owner passes on. Only
from a login, never a token.

400.description: invalid: a name, a password under 10 characters, or an owner with an expiry

403.description: forbidden: owners only; session_required: not from a token

delete.summary:
Delete an account, ending its sessions and revoking its tokens. Its
phones' feeder keys are revoked separately.

patch.summary:
Change an account's role, expiry or password; a password only from a
login, never a token. A role applies to the
user's tokens at once. Setting a password ends that user's sessions (an
owner's own, all but the one asking) and leaves their tokens; extending
a disabled account enables it, and its tokens with it.

400.description: invalid: a password under 10 characters, or an owner with an expiry

403.description: forbidden: owners only; session_required: a password from a token

409.description: last_owner: the household's only owner keeps the role

get.summary:
Liveness and version, without authentication: the process is up and
serving. It reads nothing, so a probe never waits on the database.

AdoptFeeder.description:
Adopt a feeder by redeeming an invite its owner created for the server
(`wellfed invite --role server`).

address.description: The feeder's `host` or `host:port`; found over mDNS when absent.

invite.description:
The invite's text, `wellfed-invite:1:…`. It holds a secret, so it
is never stored or logged.

name.description: What the household calls the feeder (1-64 characters).

AssetName.description: One asset of one of the project's releases.

oneOf.description: No pack fitted.
A value no pack of the board can read, as read.
Nothing sampled.
The last sample is this old, past the feeder's limit.

Battery.description: The battery pack, as the feeder judged its reading.

Blocked.description: Why a feed cannot start now.

oneOf.description: The server's own key.
A phone the server invited for this account, through this token.
Set once the key is to be revoked and until it is.

A client the server did not invite, which an owner chose to keep
(the owner's CLI, say).
A client the server did not invite: an owner keeps or revokes it.

ClientOwner.description: Whose a feeder's client is, as the server knows it.

ClientRole.description: A role in the feeder's own client table.

boot_count.description:
The feeder's boot count when it was sent, as the server last read
it; `None` before the server read the feeder's status.

feed.description: A feed's number in the feeder's journal, once it is known.

key.description:
The `Idempotency-Key` it was sent under; the server draws one for
a write sent without.

oneOf.description: The feeder's answer once `answered`; its history's once `resolved`.

sent.description: When it was recorded, before it was sent.

oneOf.description: The token it came through; `None` for a browser session.

CommandKind.description: What a journalled write asked of the feeder.

oneOf.description: It took effect.

A settings change took effect, and these are the settings the
server read back after it.
The feeder refused it; nothing ran.

The feeder made the invite under this number, for this many
seconds. Its secret went to the caller alone and is not kept.

The feeder reserved the feed under this number and runs it; its
result follows as `fed`.

The feed ended, as its `Fed` event in the feeder's history says.
An `uncertain` outcome may have dispensed anything up to
`requested`, and is never retried.

The feeder restarted since the feed was sent, and its history holds
no record of it: it never ran, or its record was lost. Whether food
was dispensed is not known, and it is never sent again.

CommandOutcome.description: What the feeder answered a write, or what its history says of it.

CommandPage.description: A page of the journal, oldest first.

next.description: The `after` for the next page; `None` at the end.

Connection.description: The server's session with a feeder.

secret.description:
What the client sends as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`. The
server keeps only its hash, so a lost secret is revoked and made
again.

CreatedToken.description: A token just made, with its secret: the only time the server shows it.

Credentials.description: A name and password, to log in.

ErrorCode.description: Every way a request fails. Clients branch on this, never on the title.

client.description: The new client's fingerprint (its key's first 4 bytes).

jump_ms.description: How far the clock moved, when it was valid before.

oneOf.description: Events the feeder could not record (its queue overflowed).
A feed ended.

completed.description: The portions the feedback sensor confirmed.

feed.description: The feeder's number for the feed.

oneOf.description:
The lasting reason the feeder cannot feed changed: the new reason,
or none once it can feed again.

The adapter came or went, or the pack crossed its floor (at most
one a minute, as the supply stood at its end).

below_floor.description: Whether the feeding owner judged the pack below its floor.

EventPage.description: A page of history, oldest first.

epoch.description: The history read; `None` before the server holds any.

gaps.description: The gaps that end inside the page's span.

next.description: The `after` for the next page; `None` at the newest.

portions.description: Portions to dispense (1-48; the feeder checks its own cap).

address.description: Where the server last reached it.

archived.description: When it was removed from the server; `None` while it is mirrored.

epoch.description: The feeder's history epoch `synced` counts in.

role.description: The role the feeder enrolled the server's key with.

synced.description: The newest event the server holds, `None` before the first.

FeederClient.description: One client the feeder has enrolled, and whose it is to the server.

FeederDetail.description: One feeder and its latest status.

oneOf.description: `None` until the server has read it once.

at.description: The feeder's clock when it happened; `None` while that was invalid.

epoch.description: The history the event belongs to.

seq.description:
The feeder's sequence number: monotonic across its reboots, within
the epoch.

FeederFood.description: A feeder's food as it stands.

oneOf.description: The food it serves now; `None` before an owner sets one.
The newest refill recorded.

FeederRefusal.description: Why the feeder refused, as it said.

FeederSample.description:
A live measurement. The feeder sends these only while the server is
subscribed and never stores them; the server keeps every one.

uptime_ms.description: The feeder's uptime when it measured.

FeederStatus.description: What the feeder reports about itself.

bank.description: The flash bank it booted from.

clock.description: The feeder's clock; `None` while it is invalid.

dns_losses.description:
Losses the feeder's link check noticed (its DHCP lease ran out or
its gateway stopped answering) rather than the association. The name
is from the internet DNS check that check replaced.

last_event.description: The newest event's sequence number on the feeder.

locked.description: The panel's child lock; `None` before it is known.

oneOf.description:
Whether a feed can start now; absent from a feeder that does not
report it.

sessions.description: Open device API sessions, the server's included.

bag_grams.description: A full bag's weight (1-100000 g): what a full-bag refill adds.

grams_per_cup.description: What a cup of it weighs (1-1000 g).

kcal_per_kg.description: Energy, as labels print it (1-10000 kcal per kg).

FoodChoice.description: `PUT /feeders/{id}/food`: the food a feeder serves from now on.

FoodHistoryPage.description: A page of a feeder's food history, oldest first.

next.description: The `after` for the next page; `None` at the end.

FoodPatch.description:
A change to a food; an absent field is left as it is. A change applies
to the past too: a new recipe is a new food.

FoodPeriod.description:
A span of time a feeder served one food: from `from` until `to`, the
next change, or still when `to` is `None`.

Gap.description: Events the feeder dropped from its ring before the server read them.

Generation.description:
A feeder store's generation: a write names the one it read, and the
feeder refuses it once the store has moved on.

zone.description:
The IANA zone, by its canonical name. Every feeder keeps it as a
POSIX rule, so its clock and plans follow DST with the server down.

HouseholdPatch.description:
A change to the household; an absent field is left as it is. A new
zone goes to every feeder: those offline get it when they reconnect.

zone.description:
An IANA zone; one a POSIX rule cannot describe is refused
`zone_unsupported`.

oneOf.description: The feeder dropped it.

It could not be revoked: the feeder still holds the key, and its
owner revokes it on the feeder (`wellfed revoke`).

KeyRemoval.description: What came of revoking the server's own key on a feeder being removed.

NewPet.description: A new pet; it starts with no feeders and no weights.

NewPhoneInvite.description:
An invite for the caller's own phone, which joins the feeder with it on
the LAN. The phone sends the public key it will join with, so the
server knows the client as this account's once it enrolls.

oneOf.description: A weighed amount (1-100000 g).

A whole bag of the feeder's current food: its `bag_grams`. A feeder
with no food set is refused `no_current_food`.

NewRefill.description: What an owner put in the hopper.

NewToken.description: A token to make, for the user asking.

expires.description:
When it stops; it lasts until revoked when absent. The account's
own expiry stops it sooner.

name.description: The device it is for (`Ada's phone`): 1-64 characters.

expires.description:
When the account stops (a pet sitter's); never when absent. An
owner's account cannot expire.

password.description: At least 10 characters: a temporary one the owner passes on.

at.description:
When it was weighed, for a reading taken earlier (a vet's); now when
absent.

PasswordChange.description: A user changing their own password: `PATCH /session`.

current.description: The password the user logs in with now.

daily_kcal.description: The calories a day the pet should eat (1-10000 kcal).

feeders.description:
The feeders that serve this pet. A feeder may serve several pets,
and its intake is then split between them as an estimate.

PetPatch.description:
A change to a pet; an absent field is left as it is, and `null` clears
an optional one.

PhoneInvite.description:
A single-use invite for the caller's phone. The text holds the secret
the phone's handshake needs, so it is shown once and never stored.

address.description: Where the server last reached the feeder.

invite.description: `wellfed-invite:1:…`, redeemed by the phone at the feeder.

role.description: The role the phone joins with: its account's.

seconds.description: How long the feeder holds the invite.

PhoneKey.description:
A phone's key on a feeder, as the server recorded it when it made the
phone's invite.

oneOf.description: Set once the key is to be revoked and until it is.

role.description: The role it was invited with.

Readiness.description:
Whether the feeder can start a feed now: the one decision a feed
request obeys too.

oneOf.description: The feeder's food when it was recorded.

grams.description: What went in: a full bag's is the bag size when it was recorded.

RefillPage.description: A page of a feeder's refills, oldest first.

next.description: The `after` for the next page; `None` at the end.

RefusedAsset.description: A release asset the server would not keep.

Release.description: A verified release in the server's cache.

added.description: When the server took it in.

id.description:
SHA-256 over the signed manifest: the name a feeder's update state
gives the install.

key_id.description: The signing key's id: the first 8 bytes of SHA-256 over it.

ReleaseCheck.description: What one check of the project's releases found.

added.description: Releases verified and added to the cache by this check.

failed.description: Assets that failed to download. The next check tries them again.

refused.description:
Assets that failed verification. Each is skipped by later checks
until the server restarts.

ReleaseFile.description: A release file's bytes, as the upload's body documents them.

ReleasePage.description: A page of releases, newest version first.

next.description: The `after` for the next page; `None` at the end.

ReleaseRefusal.description: Why a file is not a release the server keeps.

oneOf.description: An asset of one of the project's GitHub releases.
A file an owner uploaded.

Removal.description:
A feeder the server no longer mirrors. Its history, samples and journal
stay readable; adopting it again continues them.

key.description: Whether the feeder dropped the server's own key.

oneOf.description: The server had no session with the feeder; nothing was sent.
No answer came in time: the feeder may have dropped the key.

The feeder refused: `forbidden` when the server's key is not an
owner's.

RevokeAttempt.description: Why an attempt to revoke a key, or the server's own, did not land.

RevokeReason.description: Why a phone's key is revoked.

Revoking.description:
A phone key the server is revoking: tried at once, and again each time
the feeder reconnects, until the feeder has dropped it.

oneOf.description: What the last attempt came to; `None` before the first.
The heap's free bytes now, and the fewest since boot.

The loop's passes since the last loop sample: how many, the longest
and the 99th percentile.

The latest gateway round trip answered since the last gateway
sample; `None` when none was.

The joined access point's channel, and how often a join landed on
another one this boot.
The supply, judged.

feeders.description:
Every adopted feeder and the server's session with it. Read from
the database, so empty while `store` is `failing`.

jobs.description:
Each background job's last run, once it has run, in the order the
jobs are listed. Read from the database, so empty while `store` is
`failing`.

started.description: When this run of the server started.

Settings.description:
The feeder's settings. Its `generation` goes back in `If-Match` with a
change, and is the `ETag` of a read.

writable.description: Whether the settings store can take a write now.

SettingsPatch.description: The settings to change; absent fields stay as they are.

Setup.description: The first owner and the household's zone.

zone.description:
The household's IANA zone (`Europe/Berlin`). Every feeder keeps its
POSIX rule, so a zone the rule cannot describe is refused
`zone_unsupported`.

SetupState.description: Whether a fresh server is waiting for its first owner.

zone.description:
The server host's IANA zone, when it has one: the setup page offers
it as the household's zone.

client.description: The client's fingerprint (its key's first 4 bytes).

Species.description: What kind of animal a pet is.

live.description:
Read for this request, rather than the last copy from before the
feeder went offline.

StoreState.description:
Whether the database answered a trivial query on both its writer and
its readers. The failure itself is in the server's log, under the
request's id.

oneOf.description:
A journalled write changed: answered, unknown, or resolved from the
feeder's history (a feed's result). Each user is sent their own
writes; an owner, everyone's.

The stream cannot resume from the client's `Last-Event-ID`:
refetch what it shows.

TimeFormat.description: How times of day are shown.

Token.description: A token as it is listed: never its secret.

expires.description: When it stops; `None` lasts until revoked.

last_used.description:
When it last authenticated a request, to the minute; `None` until
it is first used.

user.description: Whose it is: it acts as this user, with their role as it is now.

expires.description:
When the account stops: past it, its sessions no longer work and it
cannot log in, until an owner extends or deletes it. Owners never
expire.

UserPatch.description: A change to an account; an absent field is left as it is.

expires.description:
A time sets or moves the expiry, `null` removes it. Extending a
disabled account enables it again.

password.description:
A temporary password (at least 10 characters). Setting another
user's ends their sessions.

oneOf.description: Demoting the last owner is refused `last_owner`.

Weight.description: One entry of a pet's weight log.

WeightId.description: One entry of a pet's weight log.

WeightPage.description: A page of a weight log, oldest reading first.

next.description: The `after` for the next page; `None` at the end.

WifiChange.description:
The feeder's Wi-Fi credentials for its next join, or `null` to clear
them.

psk.description:
